shortDescription: The Inpage Navigation Basic section offers a straightforward approach to category navigation using image links that encourage user interaction. It sits between the compact and large navigation variants, providing a balanced visual footprint. Tiles feature images with customizable backgrounds and optional promotional flags. The section works as a static grid or scrollable slider with configurable rows and alignment. Ideal for homepage category promotion where visual appeal matters but space is limited.
